title: KAITO — Wonderland SEKAI〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He's usually hanging out around this stage... Ah, I see him!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hello, Tsukasa.
Are your friends not coming today?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
It's just me this time.
I come to seek your wisdom, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay? What would you like to know?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You seem to be the leader of your troupe.
Can you tell me how you manage to put shows together?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: In what way?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I want to learn your secret for getting an unruly troupe of weird actors under control so that you can stage great productions.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: For me, it's a constant struggle to rein in my team so that they don't ruin everything with their crazy ideas.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My ambition to become the world's top star is at stake!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ahem... So, anyway.
I'd like some advice on how to act as a leader.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What you're asking is...how I manage to stage shows with Miku and the plushies as my actors?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Exactly. Do you bribe them with candy to get them to listen to you?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Or are you able to predict what trouble they're going to cause and stop them in time?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha, no, I don't do anything like that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then what's your secret?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The other day we did a show including some magic tricks...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You will now witness my miraculous escape!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Miku is going to pierce this box with swords, while I'm trapped inside! Miku, are you ready?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Suuure thing♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
It's stabby-stabby time☆
The first sword's goooing in!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Aaand another! Aaand a third!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And now some more!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: W-Wait! Miku, I asked you to use only three swords, remember?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course I do! But we've got five swords here. Wouldn't it be a shame not to use them all?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That wasn't in the plan!!!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Without further ado, here we go~☆
bgm_area00004

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Holy cow, that's terrifying!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. Luckily, it turns out I'm more flexible than I thought.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How can you just laugh it off...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Miku's improvisation proved very popular with the audience and we got a huge applause.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Of course it's best when everybody in the troupe shares the same vision, but accidents happen, and isn't it our job as showmen to deal with that?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's why it never occurred to me to try to exert control over my troupe.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: My role is to enable them to put on the most exciting shows they can think of.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I guess that's our lot...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But doesn't that mean I just have to put up with the insane antics of my crazy team?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
It's a trade-off.
It's more difficult for you, but makes for more fun, exciting shows.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're right, can't disagree with that...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You know what each member's forte is, and how to bring it to the forefront. You're going to make an exceptional leader.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well, I am the world's top star-to-be after all!
